text: Docket — built by Rita for Monad Metropolis
say: Docket. Built by Rita, for the Monad Metropolis hackathon.

text: Give an AI agent money and you have a problem with three parts.
say: Give an A.I. agent money, and you have a problem with three parts.

text: It can be prompt-injected. Its key can leak. And its judgement is not yours.
say: It can be prompt injected. Its key can leak. And its judgement is not yours.

text: So today you either don't give agents money, or you hand one a key and hope.
say: So today, you either do not give agents money, or you hand one a key and hope.

text: Every existing answer buys safety with something you must trust.
say: Every existing answer buys safety with something you must trust. Hardware, or tens of seconds of proving.

text: They all stop the bad action. None of them leave a record it was attempted.
say: They all stop the bad action. None of them leave a record that it was attempted.

text: Docket puts the funds and the policy in a contract. The agent holds neither.
say: Docket puts the funds and the policy in a contract called a mandate. The agent holds neither.

text: It may call one function — so stealing its key gets an attacker nothing it couldn't already do.
say: It is granted permission to call one function, so stealing its key gets an attacker nothing the agent could not already do.

text: And a policy violation never reverts. It emits Denied and returns false.
say: And a policy violation never reverts. It emits denied, and returns false.

text: A revert would roll back its own logs — the refused attempt would vanish.
say: A revert would roll back its own logs, and the refused attempt would vanish.

text: Those refusals compute a conduct score anyone can recompute and nobody can self-award.
say: Those refusals compute a conduct score. One that anyone can recompute, and nobody can award themselves.

text: Who is it for? Teams shipping agents that move real value.
say: Who is it for? Teams shipping agents that move real value. Treasury automation, trading bots, payment agents.

text: They need a bound they can prove, not a prompt they hope holds.
say: They need a bound they can prove, not a prompt they hope holds.

text: The counterparties on the other side, who can't tell a careful agent from a reckless one.
say: The protocols and counterparties on the other side, who today cannot tell a careful agent from a reckless one.

text: And agent registries, which need a reputation that is earned rather than claimed.
say: And agent registries, which need a reputation that is earned, rather than claimed.

text: The policy check sits inside the agent's action loop, so latency is the product.
say: The policy check sits inside the agent's action loop, so latency is the product.

text: 568 ms act-to-finality on Monad. A ZK gate buys the same guarantee for 30 to 75 seconds.
say: Five hundred and sixty eight milliseconds, act to finality, on Monad testnet. A zero knowledge gate buys the same guarantee for thirty to seventy five seconds.

text: Live on Monad testnet since September. Over fifty acts, and a published score.
say: Docket has been live on Monad testnet since September. Over fifty acts, and a published score.

text: Not a prototype. A deployed contract — and one command lets anyone check it.
say: Not a prototype. A deployed contract. And one command lets anyone check it.
